diagnosticHistory.afterHeadMimeFix: manifest resolved; playback started after native player gesture

notes: The packaged Tauri UI used a local HTTP CMS fixture only to return the real public ClearKey DASH URL and UUID clearKeys. Rust proxy HEAD and GET responses exposed application/dash+xml; Shaka resolved the 60-second manifest. After an explicit player-control gesture, the media clock advanced from 0:00 to 0:05. The first-frame signal is based on the player playing event and progress, not a saved screenshot. This proves the ClearKey DASH proxy/player path on the current Win11 host; it is not clean-machine or signed-Release evidence.
